sql: WITH s AS (SELECT 1 /* DROP TABLE t */) SELECT * FROM s
WITH s AS (SELECT delete_count, update_time, merge_id FROM t) SELECT * FROM s
WITH s AS (SELECT "update" FROM t) SELECT * FROM s
why: a verb as a quoted identifier is not executed

sql: WITH s AS (SELECT 1 -/**/- 1) DELETE FROM t
why: removing the empty comment leaves '--'; a second comment pass would read it as a line comment and hide the DELETE — strip once
after the one comment pass the text starts with '--', not a verb (the engine sees two minus signs); a second pass would surface DROP
